title: Precision Flow
description: Precision Flow is a client-side modpack focused on performance and player experience
body:
# Precision Flow
PF is a refined, lightweight client-side modpack built for one purpose: uncompromising speed. It provides a smooth, stutter-free experience by focusing on essential engine fixes rather than bloating the game with unnecessary features.

### 🚀 Key Features
 ⚡️ Advanced Optimization: Powered by the best optimization mods available. Micro-stutters are eliminated, chunk loading is improved, and FPS is boosted to ensure a playable experience even on low-end hardware and laptops.

🎙 Immersive Socials: Full out-of-the-box support for Plasmo Voice and Simple Voice Chat. Crystal-clear 3D positional audio makes it the perfect choice for any multiplayer community.

🌿 Authentic Style: All improvements focus on stability and performance. The original Minecraft aesthetic remains untouched, ensuring full compatibility with vanilla servers and resource packs.

### 🖥 System Requirements:

```

Minimum RAM: 2 GB allocated.

Recommended RAM: 4 GB (For total stability and better 1% low FPS).
```
